dedupe_keys.name: simulations of earthquake induced relative settlement for earth dams subjected to induced seismicity

description: Simulations of Earthquake-Induced Relative Settlement for Earth Dams Subjected to Induced Seismicity is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Jingwen He, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). This dataset compiles earthquake-induced relative settlement (RS) data used to develop seismic demand models for earth dams subjected to induced seismicity in Central and Easter North America (CENA). The relative settlement data were derived from finite element simulations of earth dams, which include 120 homogeneous embankment dam models and 222 clay core dam models. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: earthquake, relative settlement, earth dams, induced seismicity, finite element analysis, seismic demand models. Published 2026-08-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
